name: Raising On Purpose - Pinterest via Buffer (2x daily)

parameters.content:
## Setup (do once)
1. Install the Buffer community node in n8n (Settings > Community nodes > @bufferapp/n8n-nodes-buffer) and create the `Buffer account` credential with your personal API key (Buffer > Settings > API; longest expiration).
2. Open `Buffer - Create Pin Post` and pick Organization, Channel (Pinterest), and Pinterest Board from the dropdowns. Text / Title / URLs are pre-wired; Alt Text = post title; Thumbnail left empty (optional).
3. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE (Read Sheet + Mark Pinned). Add `Pinned` and `Pinned At` columns to the same sheet.
4. Destination URLs self-heal: Resolve Post URL matches the slug against /sitemap.xml and uses the REAL post URL (sheet Category typos like family-routines-rhythms are bypassed). Falls back to the sheet-built URL if the post is not deployed yet.
5. Schedule = 9:00 + 15:00 SERVER time (Railway = UTC: set N8N_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE or shift cron). Pins join the channel queue (Add to Queue). One run = one pin; empty queue = silent stop.
